title: Review and repair seeded gameplay regressions in both builds of a canvas idle game
derivation: Seeded-defect package (fallback): the public repo history has only two commits (the initial game and a README URL edit), no PRs and no issues, so no real bug fix exists to mine. Reference = the exact shipped game files index.html and foal-rescue-meadow.html (identical at base_ref and reference_ref; reference_ref changes only README.md) plus an authored review-findings.json ledger. Agent base = the same two files with 8 identical seeded regressions per build, each a one-line or two-line plausible slip: load() merges saved upgrades before defaults (upgrades reset); load() only defaults a missing idle-coin timer when it equals 0 (older-save horses never earn); processOffline() birth tries use <= capacity (meadow overfills); processOffline() coin rate divides by 3500 ms instead of 35000 ms; popBubble() restarts chains at 0; petHorse() resets the cooldown on every tap; drawBubble() records the unswayed x for the hit test; the shop buy handler charges the next level's price. Players' symptom reports cover 6 of the 8; the combo and offline-overfill defects are found only by reviewing against GAME-RULES.md, an authored description of the shipped behavior. README.md is sanitized (no personal dedication or live URL). Hidden checks extract the inline script and run it in Node 24 inside a trusted vm context with stub DOM/canvas/audio, in-memory localStorage, a controllable clock, manual requestAnimationFrame and a constant Math.random; upgrade levels are seeded after start-up where a check targets another defect, so each regression row isolates one defect. v2 (round 4): native fit failed for v1 because the writable game files (35,505 and 36,330 bytes at base and in the reference) exceed the default native per-file limit of 32,768 bytes; real game files are this size and the stock CLI has no such cap, so the task content is byte-identical and only this package's native limits are raised: bytes 131,072 (>= 2x the largest writable file), channel and finalOutputReserve 131,072 (a whole escaped artifact per read/collection), payload 524,288 (a full-file write after JSON escaping plus headroom) and aggregate 8 MiB. Shared broker defaults unchanged.
coverage: Gameplay behavior on held-out saves (current, older-version, unreadable), absences from 45 s to 9 h via start-up and visibility return, chains, petting cadence, swaying-bubble taps, shop purchases, growth/births and rescue landing; 8 defects checked in both builds; closed-vocabulary review ledger with false-positive check.
historical_exposure: Public repo; the reference is the shipped game, so recall of the repo is possible but the seeded defects and checks are new.
residual_rubric: Quality of free-text defect descriptions and locations is recorded for later review, never model-judged.
Category 'herd' and 'rendering' are not counted as false positives because the offline-births and hit-test defects could be argued into them.
Visual drawing, audio and toast wording are not graded.
required_environment: cloud-linux: Node 24 only (stub browser in trusted vm). A full check of drawing, touch feel and iOS Safari home-screen behavior would need a headless browser (Playwright) and a phone, which the grader images do not provide.
